name.en: Blum AVENTOS HK top lift mechanism (system screws)

articles.note: front fixing bracket set, wooden fronts

source: Blum AVENTOS HK top data sheet (AU edition): power factor LF = cabinet height [mm] × front weight incl. double handle weight [kg]; cabinet height 205–600, front ≤ 18 kg with two mechanisms; system-screw version: Ø5 × 11.5 holes on a line 36 below the top edge at 37, 69, 133, 165 from the front edge. Front bracket 20S4200 is screwed on (4 screws per side at 62 + FAo, then 32 apart, 12.5 from the side's inner face) and not drilled here. See docs/hardware-research/hanging-flaps.json.
